_comment: Maintainer-curated presentation data for the community gallery. Keyed by extension slug (the `id` build_registry.py derives from the package's magic.json name). Everything here is optional: packages without an entry fall back to sensible defaults. This file is an INPUT to build_registry.py; community_registry.json is generated OUTPUT and should never be hand-edited.

_schema.tags: Filter tags shown in the gallery ribbon. Valid: ambient, focus, newtab, tech.
_schema.art_image: Preview image path relative to web/. Must exist on disk.
_schema.category: Primary category used for the card label. Defaults to the first tag.
_schema.featured: Set true on exactly one extension to pin it to the large hero card.
